+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,45 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+> **Note:** there are no test files in this repository yet. The commands below
+> are the intended workflow; today they will collect and run zero tests.
+
+The project is plain Python with no dependencies and no packaging metadata, so
+no install step is required. Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org):
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pytest
+```
+
+If pytest is not available in your environment:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pip install pytest
+```
+
+Useful variations:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pytest -v                        # verbose, one line per test
+python3 -m pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py   # a single file
+python3 -m pytest -k reconcile              # only tests matching an expression
+```
+
+### Adding tests
+
+Place test files in a `tests/` directory at the repository root, named
+`test_*.py`, with test functions named `test_*`. Since the modules live at the
+root of the repository, run pytest from the repository root so that
+`import pricing_cache` and friends resolve:
+
+```sh
+cd /path/to/repo
+python3 -m pytest
+```
+
+The standard library's `unittest` also works if you prefer it:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
+```
